scope.task: Fourth G1+ crawl round: close the three remaining zero-cost and free-programmable gaps with read-only agents
scope.coordinator_role: froze the write set, re-checked every machine-readable claim against the tracked working tree, merged the evidence, changed no canonical data

agents.target: four unclosed primary sources via open routes

scope.rate_limit_notes: No agent exceeded the 40-call per-agent sub-cap and no HTTP 429 retry storm was issued. This is the first round in which the sub-cap was respected by every agent.

gate_results.question: Was the earlier 'no local ThermoML observation' verdict produced from an incomplete extraction?
gate_results.answer: Yes for the file that was previously read as the local ThermoML table, and no for the tracked observation-level extraction. data/processed/thermoml_normalized.csv is a five-file subset: its own provenance records raw_file_count=5 and row_count=625 with filter=dielectric_only. An independent reparse of all 242 local XMLs finds 91 files carrying structured dielectric observations and 11,646 dielectric PropertyValues, of which 11,021 are absent from the normalized file. Zero rows of the normalized file are absent from the XMLs, so the gap runs one way.
gate_results.tracked_extraction_holds: An independent reparse reproduces data/processed/dielectric_raw.csv exactly as a multiset over DOI + data_number + property_name + value + temperature + InChIKey: 11,646 of 11,646 rows match, with the only normalisation being the zero-frequency frequency field ('0' in the tracked table against '' in the XML).

class_A_new_molecule_zero_frequency.gate: every row sits above the frozen near-room band (315.65-353.15 K and 333.15-373.15 K respectively), so none is ingestable without a temperature-band decision

class_B_same_molecule_new_source_zero_fr.gate: 2,200-29,400 kPa, i.e. a high-pressure series, so it is a pressure cross-check and not an ambient replacement for the stored NBS Circular 514 value

frequency_dependent.gate: frequency-dependent observations cannot be merged into a near-zero-frequency static column without the frequency gate

archive_integrity.verdict: not a readable gzip stream: the gzip magic is absent and 95.6 percent of the file is zero bytes. The local 242-XML cache, not this archive, is the effective evidence base.

gate_results.question: Can the DC-200 dielectric dataset be retrieved and identity-gated against the local 246 rows?
gate_results.paper: Zhang et al., ACS Nano 2026, 'Unlocking the Chemical Space for Rechargeable Batteries with a Generative Solvent Design System', PMC13422007, DOI 10.1021/acsnano.6c06255
gate_results.evidence_quote: we curated 200 aprotic samples measured experimentally at room temperature from the literature and public databases (82, 83) and refer to this data set as DC-200.
gate_results.experimental_not_computed: The dielectric constants are experimental. The computed quantity the paper pairs with them is a dipole moment used to build a linear-fitting model, not a computed permittivity.

carrier.local_cache_match: byte-identical to the already-cached data/external/g1plus/compilations/nn6c06255_si_001.pdf, so the coordinator re-derived the parse from an independently downloaded copy

coordinator_local_recheck.additional_fact: SI text states that only 138 molecules in the DC-200 dataset satisfy the same selection criteria used for constructing Batt-SLM

blocked_routes.outcome: 207 objects listed, truncated=false; no DC-200 or dielectric-constant file

source_references.ref_82: He et al. 2025, DOI 10.1063/5.0267184, oa_status=closed, oa_url=null
source_references.ref_83: Marenich et al., Minnesota Solvation Database (MNSOL) Version 2012, which self-describes 92 solvents
source_references.why_reconstruction_is_not_attempted: The paper does not state the selection rule that turns its sources into 200 rows, so the member list cannot be uniquely reconstructed from them.

overlap_with_local_246_rows.reason: DC-200 publishes no identity field, so no exact intersection size, no InChIKey list and no experimental subset can be stated. 'Members not released' must not be written as 'no overlap'.
overlap_with_local_246_rows.single_available_identity_check: Main-text Figure 3a discusses dimethoxymethane as a DC-200 member; the local 246 rows carry 1,2-dimethoxyethane and 1,1-dimethoxyethane but not dimethoxymethane. That says nothing about the other 199 members.

gate_results.question: Can any of the four unclosed primary sources be read on an open route?
gate_results.common_result: All four citations were confirmed bibliographically through Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar. None yielded a readable table: OUP and RSC answer 403, the Springer chapter redirects to an identity provider, HAL returns numFound=0 for both the DOI and the title, and Google Books, Internet Archive and NDL Search did not respond. Europe PMC holds none of the four.

per_source.role: named candidate primary source for the FEC 107 leg
per_source.blocking_reason: bibliography and abstract confirm that permittivities of substituted dioxolan-2-ones were measured, but the abstract carries no number and the full text sits behind an OUP 403; J-STAGE and CiNii timed out this round
per_source.honest_boundary: not obtained is not the same as not existing

per_source.citation: Ue, Sasaki, Tanaka & Morita, Modern Aspects of Electrochemistry (2014), DOI 10.1007/978-1-4939-0302-3_2, pp. 93-165
per_source.blocking_reason: link.springer.com returns 303 to idp.springer.com/authorize; no open full text, and Google Books, Internet Archive and NDL Search did not respond
per_source.honest_boundary: the prior transcription '4-Fluoro-1,3-dioxolan-2-one (FEC) 106 1.50 107 4.1 -13.30 1.45' remains a previously recorded manual observation; it was not re-derived this round and must not be presented as a fresh reading

per_source.role: listed in the repository as the Saadi 1966 ticket for adiponitrile / glutaronitrile
per_source.blocking_reason: RSC answers 403 even on the free landing page
per_source.identifier_correction: The DOI title is 'Physicochemical studies of some cyclic carbonates. Part V. The alkaline hydrolysis of vinylene carbonate'. It is a vinylene carbonate paper, not an adiponitrile or glutaronitrile paper. A Crossref author-and-bibliographic search for Saadi 1966 with adiponitrile / glutaronitrile / dielectric returned no such paper. The contested ECW-308 values 30 and 37 trace to Duncan 2013, not to this DOI, whereas the values the dataset actually stores for these two rows are 32.12 and 34.6 from ThermoML 10.1021/je300958c.
per_source.consequence: The blocked ticket must be re-labelled. Either the identifier is mismatched, or the intended source is a different Saadi paper. Until that is settled, the ticket must not be cited as 'the adiponitrile primary source'.

per_source.citation: Flamme et al., Green Chem. 19(8), 1828-1849 (2017), DOI 10.1039/c7gc00252a
per_source.role: named in the repository as the upstream of the FEC 78.4 leg
per_source.blocking_reason: RSC 403; OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar both report CLOSED; HAL has no record by DOI or by title
per_source.boundary_correction: The repository chain carries PC 64.9, EC 89 and VC viscosity from this paper, so it is not established as the FEC 78.4 primary measurement and must not be promoted to one before its tables are read.

dataset_impact.canonical_sha256_revision_note: Re-pinned on 2026-09-25 by the v0.3.12 FEC/VC provenance revision; the crawl round recorded in this file itself changed no cell of the dataset.
dataset_impact.statement: This round changed no cell of the canonical dataset. The v0.3.11 FEC metadata revision was landed separately by the coordinator before this round's evidence was merged and is recorded in its own decision-log entry.

backlog: Temperature-band decision before the 33 class-A zero-frequency rows (18-crown-6, butanedinitrile) can be ingested; all of them sit above the frozen near-room band.
Pressure gate before the 145 dimethyl ether high-pressure rows can be used for anything other than a cross-check.
Frequency gate before the 550 class-A and 344 class-B frequency-dependent rows can be used at all.
Re-label or replace the Saadi 1966 blocked ticket, which currently carries a vinylene carbonate identifier.
DC-200: no action is possible until the authors release the member list; the requirement is now recorded as a data-availability request rather than an access failure.
honest_boundary: The ThermoML re-audit proves a statement about the 242 locally cached XMLs only. It is not a statement about the whole ThermoML 2020 corpus.
The completeness gap is a documentation defect in a helper file, not a defect in the tracked observation-level extraction; the latter was independently reproduced row for row.
'DC-200 members not released' is not 'no overlap with the local dataset'. The intersection is unknown and is recorded as unknown.
Blocked access is recorded as an access failure naming the document and the specific failure; no blocked path is written as absence of data.
The FEC 78.4 and 107 legs remain unread at primary level. This round narrows where each leg lives and does not promote either one.
No claim is made about compounds outside the frozen 246-row dataset.
revision_note: v1 (2026-09-25): first round in which every agent respected the 40-call per-agent sub-cap; merged the ThermoML completeness re-audit, the DC-200 availability investigation and the four unclosed primary sources into one evidence file.
